name: Runner Extras - App Group Visibility Subscriber
brief: Issue #4448: an app group that does not declare 'AGVI Precompiled Install Dep' raises the event that package subscribes to. The subscriber's own table must stay visible to the subscriber's code while this group executes.
description: Issue #4448. A precompiled dependency's event subscribers are bound bundle-wide, so they fire under app groups outside the package's closure. App-group visibility widens by the closure of every app whose code is on the call stack, so the subscriber still finds its own table 66360 in AllObj. Meaningful only in the combined tests/runner-extras run, where app-group-visibility-install-dep registers the package; run on its own the subscriber is never bound and the test fails. Runner-specific: the corpus runs one app set per service tier.
